purpose: Verify generated MPOLYGON callback delivery of version/fill metadata and OCS boundary loop vertices, plus explicit WCS projection through the shared HATCH coordinate helper.

authority.relevantFields: The reference states the boundary path, elevation and extrusion groups are shared with MPolygon, and identifies its version, solid-fill and ACI fill-color groups.

assertions: versioned solid/associativity and distinct ACI/RGB fill fields
one type-2 loop with one closed polyline and three vertices
capture.coordinateRule: DRW_Hatch::applyExtrusion leaves MPOLYGON boundary callback coordinates in OCS; WCS values are computed explicitly with the inherited DRW_Hatch::boundaryPointToWcs helper.

scopeLimit: Generated same-library DXF callback transport and explicit local coordinate-helper behavior only. Does not establish independent DXF interoperability, DWG producer semantics, fill rendering, native consumer behavior or broad MPOLYGON support.
claimEffect: No format or consumer support claim changes.
